set-variable.name: throttleState
set-variable.value: @{ JObject loaded = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<JObject>("throttleState", null); JObject map = (loaded != null && loaded["backends"] != null && loaded["backends"].Type == JTokenType.Object) ? (JObject)loaded["backends"] : new JObject(); return new JObject( new JProperty("dirty", false), new JProperty("backends", map) ); }

set-variable.name: listBackends
set-variable.value: @{ JArray backends = (JArray)context.Variables["listBackends"]; JObject state = (JObject)((JObject)context.Variables["throttleState"])["backends"]; DateTime now = DateTime.UtcNow; foreach (JObject b in backends) { DateTime wakeAt = state.Value<DateTime?>(b.Value<string>("affinity")) ?? DateTime.MinValue; bool isThrottling = wakeAt > now; b["isThrottling"] = isThrottling; b["retryAfter"] = isThrottling ? wakeAt : DateTime.MinValue; } return backends; }

set-variable.name: ErrorScenario
set-variable.value: @{ /* Error Scenario */ JArray backends = (JArray)context.Variables["listBackends"]; JArray priorityBackendIndxs = (JArray)context.Variables["PriBackendIndxs"]; JObject wrapper = (JObject)context.Variables["throttleState"]; JObject state = (JObject)wrapper["backends"]; var backendIndex = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<int>("backendIndex", -1); var arr = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<JArray>("activityLog", new JArray()); var elapsedStr = context.Elapsed.TotalSeconds.ToString("F3"); var callAttempted = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<bool>("callAttempted", false); DateTime now = DateTime.UtcNow; if ( backendIndex < 0 || backendIndex >= backends.Count) { if ( callAttempted ) { arr.Add(new JObject {{ "Elapsed", elapsedStr },{ "message", $"Invalid backend index: {backendIndex}" }}); } else { var throttled = new List<string>(); foreach (int i in priorityBackendIndxs) { JObject b = (JObject)backends[i]; if (!b.Value<bool>("isThrottling")) { continue; } DateTime retryAfter = b.Value<DateTime>("retryAfter"); var remainingSeconds = retryAfter > now ? (int)Math.Ceiling((retryAfter - now).TotalSeconds) : 0; var retryAfterText = string.Format("{0:00}:{1:00}", remainingSeconds / 60, remainingSeconds % 60); throttled.Add(b.Value<string>("label") + " - " + retryAfterText); } string msg = "THROTTLED: (" + (throttled.Count > 0 ? string.Join(", ", throttled) : "none") + ")"; arr.Add(new JObject {{ "Elapsed", context.Elapsed.TotalSeconds.ToString("F3") },{ "message", msg }}); } return 4; /* unknown */ } JObject backend = (JObject)backends[backendIndex]; var lastStatusCode = context.Response?.StatusCode ?? 0; var callCompleted = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<bool>("callCompleted", true); var wasLimited = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<bool>("wasLimited", false); var startTime = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<DateTime>("CallAttemptStartTime", now); var deltaSeconds = (now - startTime).TotalSeconds; var requestTimeout = backend.Value<int>("timeout"); bool likelyTimeout = deltaSeconds >= (requestTimeout * 0.9); string label = backend.Value<string>("label"); string id = backend.Value<string>("affinity"); if ( callCompleted ) { return lastStatusCode == 200 ? 0 : 1; } if ( likelyTimeout || wasLimited || lastStatusCode >= 500 ) { /* Not completed with a throttle-worthy signal: record in the shared map (by id) */ DateTime wakeAt = now.AddSeconds(10); DateTime existingWake = state.Value<DateTime?>(id) ?? DateTime.MinValue; if (wakeAt > existingWake) { state[id] = wakeAt; wrapper["dirty"] = true; } backend["isThrottling"] = true; backend["retryAfter"] = state.Value<DateTime?>(id) ?? wakeAt; } int scenario; string message; if ( likelyTimeout) { scenario = 2; /* timeout */ message = $"Throttling {label} by 10s, likely timeout Elapsed: {deltaSeconds:F1}s Timeout: {requestTimeout}s"; } else if ( wasLimited ) { scenario = 3; /* concurrency limit */ message = $"Throttling {label} by 10s, concurrency limit"; } else if ( lastStatusCode >= 500 ) { scenario = 1; /* error */ message = $"Throttling {label} by 10s, status {lastStatusCode}"; } else { scenario = 4; /* unknown */ message = $"Error status {lastStatusCode} after {deltaSeconds:F1}s"; } arr.Add(new JObject {{ "Elapsed", elapsedStr },{ "message", message }}); return scenario; }

set-variable.name: backendIndex
set-variable.value: @{ try { JArray backends = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<JArray>("listBackends", new JArray()); JArray priorityBackendIndxs = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<JArray>("PriBackendIndxs", new JArray()); if (backends.Count == 0 || priorityBackendIndxs.Count == 0) { return -1; } bool contextWindowExceeded = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<bool>("contextWindowExceeded", false); int backendCallCount = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<int>("backendCallCounter", 0); if (backendCallCount == 0 && !contextWindowExceeded) { int affinityBackendIdx = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<int>("RequestAffinityBackendIdx", -1); if (affinityBackendIdx >= 0 && affinityBackendIdx < backends.Count) { JObject affinityBackend = (JObject)backends[affinityBackendIdx]; if (!affinityBackend.Value<bool>("isThrottling")) { return affinityBackendIdx; } } } var availableBackends = new List<int>(); int lowestPriority = int.MaxValue; foreach (int i in priorityBackendIndxs) { JObject backend = (JObject)backends[i]; if (backend.Value<bool>("isThrottling") || (contextWindowExceeded && backend.Value<string>("label") == "PTU")) { continue; } int priority = backend.Value<int>("priorityGroup"); if (priority > lowestPriority) { continue; } if (priority < lowestPriority) { lowestPriority = priority; availableBackends.Clear(); } availableBackends.Add(i); } return availableBackends.Count == 0 ? -1 : availableBackends[new Random(context.RequestId.GetHashCode()).Next(availableBackends.Count)]; } catch (Exception ex) { var errArr = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<JArray>("lastPolicyError", null); if (errArr != null) { errArr.Clear(); var msg = ex.Message ?? "Exception has no Message"; if (msg.Length > 300) { msg = msg.Substring(0, 300) + "..."; } errArr.Add(new JObject { { "code", "backendIndex-update" }, { "message", msg }, { "utc", DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("o") } }); } return -1; } }

set-variable.name: shouldLimit
set-variable.value: @{ try { /* Check if the backend should limit concurrency */ JArray backends = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<JArray>("listBackends", new JArray()); int backendIndex = (int)context.Variables["backendIndex"]; if (backendIndex < 0 || backendIndex >= backends.Count) { return "off"; } JObject backend = (JObject)backends[backendIndex]; return backend.Value<string>("limitConcurrency"); } catch (Exception ex) { var errArr = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<JArray>("lastPolicyError", null); if (errArr != null) { errArr.Clear(); var msg = ex.Message ?? "Exception has no Message"; if (msg.Length > 300) { msg = msg.Substring(0,300) + "..."; } errArr.Add(new JObject { { "code", "shouldLimit-update" }, { "message", msg }, { "utc", DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("o") } }); } return "off"; } }

set-variable.name: activityLog
set-variable.value: @{ var arr = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<JArray>("activityLog", new JArray()); var backends = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<JArray>("listBackends", new JArray()); var priorityBackendIndxs = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<JArray>("PriBackendIndxs", new JArray()); bool contextWindowExceeded = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<bool>("contextWindowExceeded", false); int unthrottledCount = 0; foreach (int i in priorityBackendIndxs) { JObject backend = (JObject)backends[i]; if (!backend.Value<bool>("isThrottling") && (!contextWindowExceeded || backend.Value<string>("label") != "PTU")) { unthrottledCount++; } } int remainingRetries = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<int>("RetryCount"); int policyCycle = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<int>("PolicyCycleCounter"); var retryState = remainingRetries == 0 ? "exhausted" : remainingRetries.ToString(); arr.Add(new JObject { { "Elapsed", context.Elapsed.TotalSeconds.ToString("F3")}, { "message", $"RETRIES LEFT: {retryState} CYCLE: {policyCycle} Unthrottled Backends: {unthrottledCount}" } }); return arr; }
